title: Z9.F — Selected rational quartic coefficients equal (b,a) S F inverse
milestone_description: For even n≥2 and integer target values b,a, the coefficients of the selected rational quartic with actual output (b,0,0,0,a) are exactly (b,a) times the two-row selection matrix times the actual F inverse. The preimage is rational; neither integral polynomial coefficients nor a height or denominator bound is asserted.
